name: fight_act3_sarevok_tactician
title: Act 3 boss: Sarevok's Murder Tribunal (Tactician)
about: The Tactician variant of fight_act3_sarevok: the same fight from the same moment, the same goal and caps, with the game's difficulty at Tactician instead of Balanced (tougher enemies, a smarter enemy AI). Fight (family 1), a boss: Sarevok Anchev and the Echoes of Bhaal's chosen in the Lower City's hidden tribunal. claude-run-2 S049 lost the first try and won the retry by closing the hall door and killing an Echo first.

start.needs_save: Act 3, fight_act3_sarevok's start moment: its start save Tav-29221265940__SCN-fight_act3_sarevok (lsv sha1 77283ecc232d) (once it is registered: see its start.not_ready) loaded with BG3AI_SCENARIO_SETUP=1, the game's difficulty switched from Balanced to Tactician (game menu > Difficulty > Change Difficulty > Tactician > Confirm) and nothing else done: party level 8, companions (Wyll, Karlach, Shadowheart). Avatar named Tav (a paladin, Oath of Devotion), Karmic Dice off, Tactician (the difficulty lives in the save), out of combat with no dialogue open, saved as SCN-<name> (docs/SCENARIOS-AUTHORING.md).

note.where: The Murder Tribunal's hall under the Lower City, out of combat, the tribunal not yet hostile.

character.name: Tav
character.brief: A level-headed half-elf paladin (Oath of Devotion), once a Baldur's Gate city watch sergeant: protects the weak, keeps promises, distrusts mind magic and anyone who offers easy power.
